title: Armchair
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- backrest -->
  <rect x="20" y="18" width="60" height="45" rx="12" ry="12" fill="#e05a5a"/>
  <rect x="26" y="24" width="48" height="34" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#f07a7a"/>
  <!-- seat cushion -->
  <rect x="15" y="52" width="70" height="22" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#d94a4a"/>
  <rect x="20" y="56" width="60" height="14" rx="5" ry="5" fill="#ef6b6b"/>
  <!-- left armrest -->
  <rect x="10" y="38" width="14" height="38" rx="6" ry="6" fill="#c93a3a"/>
  <rect x="13" y="42" width="8" height="28" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#e05555"/>
  <!-- right armrest -->
  <rect x="76" y="38" width="14" height="38" rx="6" ry="6" fill="#c93a3a"/>
  <rect x="79" y="42" width="8" height="28" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#e05555"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="22" y="74" width="8" height="14" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#8a5a30"/>
  <rect x="70" y="74" width="8" height="14" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#8a5a30"/>
  <!-- seat highlight lines -->
  <line x1="30" y1="62" x2="70" y2="62" stroke="#f89a9a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- little cushion on seat -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="12" ry="6" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="10" ry="4" fill="#ffe08a"/>
  <!-- cute face on backrest -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="36" r="3" fill="#3d1f1f"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="36" r="3" fill="#3d1f1f"/>
  <path d="M43 42 Q50 48 57 42" stroke="#3d1f1f" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- small feet highlights -->
  <rect x="23" y="80" width="6" height="3" rx="1.5" ry="1.5" fill="#b07a4a"/>
  <rect x="71" y="80" width="6" height="3" rx="1.5" ry="1.5" fill="#b07a4a"/>
</svg>
